title: Light Novel 'Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu' Concludes with 10th Volume
content:
The official X account for author Nana Mikoshiba announced on Tuesday that the Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu: Sekai Saikyou no Majutsushi de Aru Shounen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ni Nyuugaku suru ( The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ) light novel series will end with its tenth volume, scheduled to be released on December 2.

The main story has already concluded, with the final volume featuring revised and expanded side stories from the web novel, as well as an original story covering Ray White's college years.

Mikoshiba began writing the action fantasy light novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in October 2019. Kodansha began publishing the novel under its Ranobe Bunko imprint in July 2020, with illustrations by Riko Korie ( Juuou Mujin no Fafnir ). The ninth volume was published on June 2.

Norihito Sasaki serialized the manga adaptation in Magazine pocket from June 2020 to January 2024. Kodansha released the 16th volume in April 2024.

A sequel manga adaptation by Nao Kagami, titled Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu II began serialization on the Suiyoubi no Sirius web service on May 27.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga in English in October 2021. The 13th volume went on sale on June 2.

Produced by Cloud Hearts , the first season aired as a 12-episode series in Winter 2023. The second season was produced by Zero-G and began airing on October 9. Crunchyroll simulcast both seasons with subtitles in multiple languages and an English dub.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Hollywood Reporter, Variety: Apple TV in Talks for Monarch: Legacy of Monsters Season 3
content:
Entertainment news magazines The Hollywood Reporter and Variety reported on October 29 that Apple TV and Legendary Television are in talks for a possible third season of the Monarch: Legacy of Monsters series, part of Warner Bros. and Legendary Entertainment 's "Monsterverse" franchise . According to their sources, a hypothetical third season would have a new showrunner and writers, as well as new Titan monsters. Variety's sources added that some people have already been approached to be the new showrunner for the season.

Monarch: Legacy of Monsters , Warner Bros. and Legendary Entertainment 's series featuring Godzilla and the Titans premiered with its first 10-episode season worldwide on Apple TV+ in November 2023, and the second 10-episode season ran from February 27 to May 1 earlier this year.

The series has a separate, planned spinoff series , which will star Wyatt Russell playing young Lee Shaw (his father Kurt Russell played the character in Monarch: Legacy of Monsters ), as well as Millie Brady, Pilou Asbaek, Corey Stoll, Ralph Ineson, and Nyasha Hatendi. The series is set in 1984, and sees the character Lee Shaw infiltrating the Soviet Union to prevent them from using a Titan monster to win the Cold War. Connie Nielsen and Stana Katic have also joined the cast. Joby Harold is the showrunner for the spinoff.

The series is part of Legendary Entertainmment's "Monsterverse" Hollywood franchise currently includes the 2014 Godzilla film, the 2017 Kong: Skull Island film, the 2019 Godzilla: King of the Monsters film, the 2021 Godzilla vs. Kong film, the 2023 animated series Skull Island , and the 2024 Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire . The Godzilla x Kong: Supernova sequel film will open on March 26, 2027.

Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire is the highest-grossing movie in the franchise , with US$570 million earnings worldwide, beating the 2017 film Kong: Skull Island , which earned US$568.8 million.

title: Shueisha Games to Publish Nightmare Operator Action Horror Game
content:
Shueisha Games announced on Tuesday that it will publish game developer DDDistortion's third-person action horror shooter NIGHTMARE OPERATOR , which will launch on PC via Steam . The announcement also presented the game's teaser trailer, key art, and voice actress Miyuki Sawashiro as the voice of protagonist Misha.

Shueisha Games describes the game:

"Some problems can only be solved with a bullet." NIGHTMARE OPERATOR is a third-person action horror shooter set in a ruined, 2036 Tokyo overrun by supernatural creatures known as Yokai. Players take on the role of Public Safety Operator Misha, whose investigation into a terrorist attack draws her into a dangerous web of conspiracy, human sacrifice, and betrayal. Combining intense shooter combat with fighting game-inspired mechanics, players must hone their skills to survive, uncover the truth, and keep up with the onslaught of Yokai.

Shueisha established Shueisha Games in 2022 with the aim to develop smartphone games with original concepts and character designs from manga creators from Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine. Shueisha Games launched Schrödinger's Call for Nintendo Switch and PC via Steam on May 28, then on Switch 2 on October 28.

The company will launch Wild Wild Eden , Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivation , and Hoshin Engi Re:surrection in 2027.

title: Devils' Crest Anime Confirms Half-Year Run
content:
The official website for Devils' Crest , the television anime of Reki Kawahara 's Demons' Crest novel series, confirmed on Tuesday that the anime will run for two consecutive cours (quarters of a year).

Yen Press licensed the novels, and it describes the story:

The latest VRMMORPG, Actual Magic, has sealed an entire class of sixth graders in a terrifying game of life or death. Countless dangers await eleven-year-old Yuuma and his friends. One of their classmates has been turned into a monster, and gargantuan beasts lurk around every corner. Their only hope? The demon Valac who has possessed Yuuma's twin sister. Following Valac's guidance, Yuuma and his party set out to save their missing friend, Nagi. But an unexpected encounter awaits them...

The anime stars:

• Haruka Shiraishi as Yuma Ashihara

• Konomi Inagaki as Sawa Ashihara

• Yūya Hirose as Kenji Kondō

• Satomi Amano as Minagi Sano

• Yūsuke Kobayashi as Teruki Sugamo

• Maaya Uchida as Aria Misono

• Rie Murakawa as Kai Kisanuki

• Sora Amamiya as Sumika Watamaki

• Atsushi Tamaru as Shin Haizaki

• Ayumu Murase as Kakeru Niki

Shinji Ushiro ( Yōkai Watch , Mazica Party , Scum of the Brave ) is the anime's chief director at Production I.G , and Kenichirō Komaya ( Nina the Starry Bride , Kizuna no Allele ) is directing the anime. Eiji Umehara ( Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- scripts, series composition for Suicide Squad ISEKAI ) is overseeing the series scripts, and the original novels' illustrator Yukiko Horiguchi is designing the characters. Yūki Hayashi ( My Hero Academia , Haikyu!! ) and Naoyuki Chikatani ( Ya Boy Kongming! live-action series and film, I Want to Escape from Princess Lessons anime) are composing the music.

Ado performs the opening theme song "Shinka" (Evolution), and Soala performs the ending theme song "ReaL."

The anime premiered worldwide on November 6 on Amazon Prime Video .

Kawahara launched the novel series in November 2022. Kadokawa released the fourth novel volume in December 2025. Yen Press released the third novel volume in English in December 2025. Artist Tomoe and scriptwriter Koroku Takano launched a vertical-scrolling manga adaptation of the novels on Wit Studio 's vertical-scrolling manga service HykeComic in November 2022. Kadokawa released the manga's first compiled book volume in June 2024, and released both the second and third volumes on October 23.

Kawahara is best known for his Sword Art Online novels.The series has inspired novel and manga spinoffs, a television anime adaptation with several seasons, an anime film, and proposed live-action series . Kawahara's Sword Art Online: Progressive spinoff novel series inspired two anime films of its own.

Kawahara also penned the Accel World novel series, which inspired its own manga adaptations, a television anime adaptation, and an anime film. He also penned The Isolator: Realization of Absolute Solitude light novel series. Yen Press is releasing the Sword Art Online , Accel World , and The Isolator: Realization of Absolute Solitude novels in English.
author: ANN

title: Millennium Family TV Anime Casts Mutsumi Tamura
content:
The staff for the television anime of Sho Kasugai 's Millennium Family ( Odoru Sennen Kazoku ) manga announced on Tuesday that Mutsumi Tamura voices Arthur, the fifth son and youngest child of the Benfield family.

The anime will star:

• Rikuya Yasuda as Theo

• Katsuyuki Konishi as Hayden

• Ryōta Suzuki as Hugo

• Lynn as Eve

• Taihi Kimura as Noel

• Haruna Mikawa as Raine

Masato Jinbo ( Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya 2wei! /2wei Herz!/3rei!! , Chaos;Child , The Rising of The Shield Hero Season 2 ) is directing the anime at PartsCraft , and is also supervising the scripts. Hiroshi Yoneda ( Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya: Vow in the Snow ) is the character designer and chief animation director.

AI localization company Orange Inc. 's e-bookstore service emaqi licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Seven immortal siblings born in England possess humanity's ultimate dream: eternal life. But their gift makes them targets for the criminal underworld, corrupt hospitals, and international military organizations! After centuries apart, this extraordinary family reunites for a thrilling new chapter in their lives.

The anime will air on TBS and other stations.

Kasugai launched the manga in Shōnengahōsha 's Young King Ours magazine in March 2021. Shōnengahōsha will release the manga's 10th compiled book volume on January 29.

title: Kyūgō's Monster in Sheep's Clothing BL Manga Gets Live-Action Film
content:
An official X (formerly Twitter ) account opened last month for the live-action film adaptation of Kyūgō 's Monster in Sheep's Clothing ( Hitsuji no Kawa o Kita Kemono ) manga. The film will open in Japan on December 11, after having premiered at the Tokyo International Film Festival (TIFF) on October 28.

TIFF describes the story:

College junior Daichi is wary of Igawa, his sister's seemingly perfect fiancé, wondering why a man like him would choose her. But as Igawa supports him through his struggles with recruiting and life, Daichi finds himself falling for him. He knows he shouldn't, yet he cannot stop his feelings for this forbidden love …

The film stars Nobuyuki Suzuki as Jun Igawa (right in image above) and Bullet Train boy group member Haru Kashiwagi as Daichi Kusakabe. Additional cast members include Rinka Kumada , Nagisa Saitō , Kaito Yoshimura, Toshie Negishi , and Reika Kirishima .

Yang Liping directed the film, and Erika Nakayama and Daishi Iga wrote the script. Hidekazu Sakamoto composed the music. Amazon MGM Studio produced the film.

The film's staff started streaming a clip on Tuesday showing Daichi being thrown off by Igawa's invitation to go out for a drink together:

Tokuma Shoten published the manga's first volume in June 2021. The fourth volume will ship on December 25.

Tokyopop 's Blu imprint published in English Kyūgō 's 2008 You & Me, Etc. ( Bokura ni Matsuwaru Etcetera ) manga.

Kyūgō 's six-volume Acid Town manga serialized in Gentosha 's Rutile magazine also in 2008. Tokyopop also published the manga in English.

title: Web Manga 'Ore no Shibou Flag ga Todomaru Tokoro wo Shiranai' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
Publishing company Manga Box announced a television anime adaptation of Izumi and Mitsuya Otosu 's Ore no Shibou Flag ga Todomaru Tokoro wo Shiranai ( My Death Flags Show No Sign of Ending ) web manga on Tuesday, revealing an announcement visual (pictured above). Otosu also drew an illustration to commemorate the announcement (pictured right). The anime series will premiere in 2027.

Otosu began serializing the manga adaptation of Izumi's adventure fantasy light novel on the Manga Box web service in June 2020. The 12th volume was released digitally on March 31, with the 13th volume scheduled for a November 29 release. Takarajimasha began publishing the manga in print under its Kono Manga ga Sugoi! Comics imprint in January 2021 and published the eighth volume on January 23. The series has a cumulative 1.75 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

Izumi originally began penning the novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in November 2014. The novel won the Grand Prize at the 3rd Narou-con Grand Prize in July 2015. Takarajimasha published the light novel with illustrations by Atiki ( Shiotaiou no Satou-san ga Ore ni dake Amai ) in August 2015. The fourth volume went on sale in March 2017.

One Peace Books began publishing the manga in English under the title My Death Flags Show No Sign of Ending in June 2025. The third volume was released on March 10, with the fourth volume scheduled for release on February 23, 2027.

Synopsis Normal college student Kazuki Hirasawa finds himself inside the body of Harold Stokes, an evil character in the world of Kazuki's favorite game, Brave Hearts. The problem is, if the game's events go as they should, he'll one day find himself defeated by the hero's party. Will he be able to find a path to survival and avoid his many death flags using the incredible power of Harold Stokes's body and his own knowledge of the game? (Source: One Peace Books)

title: After Magic Knight Rayearth, This Clamp Anime Deserves a Reboot Next
content:
CLAMP is a Japanese manga group known for dozens of iconic works over the decades in the anime and manga industry. Apart from this beloved action fantasy, CLAMP also created renowned manga such as Cardcaptor Sakura , Blood-C , xxxHOLiC , and many more. The group is also the original character designer of the Code Geass franchise. Among their most successful series, Magic Knight Rayearth still remains CLAMP’s most iconic work. 2026 is an exciting year for CLAMP’s fans with the reboot anime of Magic Knight Rayearth. The reboot was released as part of the 30th anniversary project , and it became a massive hit on Crunchyroll with better adaptation and consistent animation.

However, not all of CLAMP’s works received the same treatment, despite having unique stories and premises. One of CLAMP’s most beloved and underrated series is Chobits , which began serialization in 2000 and reached its conclusion two years later. Unlike the creator’s previous works, this one leans towards a sci-fi fantasy genre . An anime adaptation by Madhouse was also released in 2002, the same year as the manga finale. The anime ended on September 24th, 2002, and despite being produced by one of the most renowned studios in Japan, it couldn’t do justice to the gorgeous world created by CLAMP, which is all the more reason it deserves an anime reboot.

Chobits Remains One of the Most Unique Sci-Fi Series of All Time

It’s actually difficult to come across such a well-written sci-fi these days, which is all the more reason why Chobits deserves its flowers. This beautiful story is based on the premise of a boy meeting a robot as the two find a genuine philosophical depth. While the series isn’t too long, it follows a coherent story with a steady pace and a satisfying conclusion. The story centers around Hideki Motosuwa, who spent four years of high school striving to get into the university of his choice. Along with attending Cram school in Tokyo, he also works daily shifts at a bar to make ends meet. Due to his busy schedule, he missed out on the world’s latest invention of perscocoms, human-like computers.

Hoping to get a persocom of his own, he comes across an abandoned one in a garbage pile. Having the appearance of a cute girl, the persocom was left behind by someone whose identity remains unknown. Regardless, Hideki names her Chii and takes her with him, only to realize she is far from an ordinary robot. As someone capable of thinking and learning on her own, she is a legendary robot known as a Chobit. He takes it upon himself to ensure Chii learns to live an ordinary life while also unraveling the truth behind the Chobits series. The story is much darker and more complex than it initially seems, as the simple romance hides the heavy themes of loneliness and sentience through artificial intelligence.

Chobits Needs a Faithful Adaptation in a Reboot Anime

While the anime fully adapted the manga, it severely deviates from the main story. The manga has a much better storyline and a satisfying conclusion that the anime failed to adapt. Since the manga hadn’t ended when the anime was released, the animation studio took liberties with the story and added fillers while also altering character dynamics to some extent. The most obvious change was in the character writing of Hideki, who was more earnest and less creepy towards Chii in the manga. It’s more than disappointing considering that Madhouse is one of the best animation studios in Japan, known for several timeless classics such as Perfect Blue, Monster, and many more.

The studio is still relevant in the 2020s, known for producing Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End , the greatest fantasy series of the decade . The 26-episode-long anime also had a completely different ending that alters the thematic depth of the story, especially considering how it had a vague resolution when it came to the feelings of Chobits . It also can’t be denied that the animation itself could be much better in the reboot with modern technology, depending on which studio will take over if there’s ever a reboot. The manga released 88 chapters, which can be squeezed into another 26-episode-long series as long as the anime reboot remains faithful to the story.

Head down to the comments to tell us your thoughts on the possible reboot of Chobits . Is it deserving of a brand new revival? Or you could tell us which CLAMP anime’s reboot you wish to see next.

Apart from this beloved action fantasy, CLAMP also created renowned manga such as Cardcaptor Sakura , Blood-C , xxxHOLiC , and many more. The group is also the original character designer of the Code Geass franchise. Among their most successful series, Magic Knight Rayearth still remains CLAMP’s most iconic work. 2026 is an exciting year for CLAMP’s fans with the reboot anime of Magic Knight Rayearth. The reboot was released as part of the 30th anniversary project , and it became a massive hit on Crunchyroll with better adaptation and consistent animation.

However, not all of CLAMP’s works received the same treatment, despite having unique stories and premises. One of CLAMP’s most beloved and underrated series is Chobits , which began serialization in 2000 and reached its conclusion two years later. Unlike the creator’s previous works, this one leans towards a sci-fi fantasy genre . An anime adaptation by Madhouse was also released in 2002, the same year as the manga finale. The anime ended on September 24th, 2002, and despite being produced by one of the most renowned studios in Japan, it couldn’t do justice to the gorgeous world created by CLAMP, which is all the more reason it deserves an anime reboot.
Chobits Remains One of the Most Unique Sci-Fi Series of All Time

It’s actually difficult to come across such a well-written sci-fi these days, which is all the more reason why Chobits deserves its flowers. This beautiful story is based on the premise of a boy meeting a robot as the two find a genuine philosophical depth. While the series isn’t too long, it follows a coherent story with a steady pace and a satisfying conclusion. The story centers around Hideki Motosuwa, who spent four years of high school striving to get into the university of his choice. Along with attending Cram school in Tokyo, he also works daily shifts at a bar to make ends meet. Due to his busy schedule, he missed out on the world’s latest invention of perscocoms, human-like computers.

Hoping to get a persocom of his own, he comes across an abandoned one in a garbage pile. Having the appearance of a cute girl, the persocom was left behind by someone whose identity remains unknown. Regardless, Hideki names her Chii and takes her with him, only to realize she is far from an ordinary robot. As someone capable of thinking and learning on her own, she is a legendary robot known as a Chobit. He takes it upon himself to ensure Chii learns to live an ordinary life while also unraveling the truth behind the Chobits series. The story is much darker and more complex than it initially seems, as the simple romance hides the heavy themes of loneliness and sentience through artificial intelligence.
Chobits Needs a Faithful Adaptation in a Reboot Anime

While the anime fully adapted the manga, it severely deviates from the main story. The manga has a much better storyline and a satisfying conclusion that the anime failed to adapt. Since the manga hadn’t ended when the anime was released, the animation studio took liberties with the story and added fillers while also altering character dynamics to some extent. The most obvious change was in the character writing of Hideki, who was more earnest and less creepy towards Chii in the manga. It’s more than disappointing considering that Madhouse is one of the best animation studios in Japan, known for several timeless classics such as Perfect Blue, Monster, and many more.

The studio is still relevant in the 2020s, known for producing Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End , the greatest fantasy series of the decade . The 26-episode-long anime also had a completely different ending that alters the thematic depth of the story, especially considering how it had a vague resolution when it came to the feelings of Chobits . It also can’t be denied that the animation itself could be much better in the reboot with modern technology, depending on which studio will take over if there’s ever a reboot. The manga released 88 chapters, which can be squeezed into another 26-episode-long series as long as the anime reboot remains faithful to the story.
